`structuredClone` keeps Dates, Maps, Sets, typed arrays and `undefined` values, and handles circular references; the JSON round trip turns Dates into strings, Maps and Sets into `{}`, drops `undefined` and functions, and throws on cycles. Neither copies functions or class prototypes (structuredClone throws on functions). So unless the data is plain JSON, `structuredClone` is the right call, and even then it's faster and clearer.
Action: find the flagged line in the PR and swap it to `structuredClone` if the data can hold dates or similar.
